method: WebFetch of each course's own birmingham.ac.uk undergraduate page (key-facts 'Fees (UK/Ireland)' line and 'Fee details'), plus the university's tuition-fee pages and subject-listing/course-search pages to find current course URLs. PARTIAL: the research session hit its usage limit partway through, so courses with empty fees and an 'unresolved' reason were NOT researched (or could not be loaded). Course pages have a 'Year of entry' selector (2027 / 2026); query-string cache-busting timed out on this site, so each course was read once from its plain URL (Physics BSc and Physics and Astrophysics MSci were read twice with the same result). GAP-FILL 2026-10-01: all remaining engineering courses read from their current course pages (plain URL; repeat fetches of two pages gave identical results). Pages split: some show "£10,050 per year for domestic (UK) students for 2027/28", others "Fees (UK/Ireland): To be confirmed". International: birmingham.ac.uk/study/international/fees gives no amounts (offer letter only); course-page country selector not readable.
